body: How do you make a map?
body_tagged: How do you make a map?
title: How do you make a map

replies.author: Shoto_
replies.body:
1. Download a Void Map
2. Load the void map
3. Build stuff
4. When it's done, take screen shots
5. Upload images to imgur
6. Make the YML. docs.avicus.net will help you, a LOT
7. Make a forum thread with YML and pictures
8. Wait for feedback

replies.author: Shoto_
replies.body: It's not actually hard, you just download a map, build, take pictures, and upload them. Also, if you don't know how to make YML, you can just ask.

replies.author: Cezbla
replies.body:
make a server or a single player world
get a void world maker plugin or mod
I recommend getting a world edit or single player commands mod for this
then you want to build the map, nexus or nebula or any game mode you are making,
you then post it on the forums and have a map dev look it over and accept or deny it
if they accept it and allow it in rotation that means you have a map in nebula or the game mode
if denied or put off then you fix it or give up
YAML can me made by you, or the map devs I know how to make it so I can make it for you
